fusions.name: Strand Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes a strand that deals 3 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Drawing Net
fusions.desc: Draws a net of strands 6.5 tiles long for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward and dealing 8 damage. Anything it catches is [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, and your afflictions on it spread to enemies within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Woven Scales
fusions.desc: Weaves a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds. It also raises your armour by 10%.

fusions.name: Snared Prey
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you gain a ward worth 10% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
